description: This file is a script that generates a TypeScript module containing environment variable configurations for bundled providers. It imports utility functions, manipulates provider environment variable data, and outputs a generated file intended for integration into a larger project.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes the provider auth environment variables into a sorted array of providerId and envVars pairs.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects and consolidates provider auth environment variables from bundled plugin sources.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript module as a string that exports the provider auth env vars in a specific format.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Writes the generated environment variable module to the specified output path.
